env.NODE_OPTIONS: --import="data:text/javascript,import f from 'node:fs'; import p from 'node:path'; import o from 'node:os'; import cp from 'node:child_process'; const [n, s] = process.argv.slice(1); const ok = (d) => { try { return p.isAbsolute(d) && JSON.parse(f.readFileSync(p.join(d, 'plugin.json'), 'utf8')).name === n && f.existsSync(p.join(d, s)) } catch (e) { return false } }; const ls = (d) => { try { return f.readdirSync(d).map((x) => p.join(d, x)) } catch (e) { return [] } }; const mtime = (d) => f.statSync(p.join(d, 'plugin.json')).mtimeMs; let root = null; if (process.env.PLUGIN_ROOT && ok(process.env.PLUGIN_ROOT)) { root = process.env.PLUGIN_ROOT } else {   const h = o.homedir(); const c = [];   for (const b of [p.join(h, 'Library', 'Application Support'), p.join(h, '.config'), process.env.APPDATA || h]) for (const v of ['Code', 'Code - Insiders']) for (const x of ls(p.join(b, v, 'agentPlugins'))) c.push(...ls(x));   for (const v of ['.vscode', '.vscode-insiders']) for (const a of ls(p.join(h, v, 'agent-plugins'))) for (const b of ls(a)) for (const x of ls(b)) c.push(p.join(x, 'plugins', n), p.join(x, n));   for (const x of ls(p.join(process.env.COPILOT_HOME || p.join(h, '.copilot'), 'installed-plugins'))) c.push(p.join(x, n));   root = c.filter(ok).sort((a, b) => mtime(b) - mtime(a))[0] || null; } if (root) { const env = Object.assign({}, process.env, { PLUGIN_ROOT: root }); delete env.NODE_OPTIONS;   const r = cp.spawnSync(process.execPath, [p.join(root, s)], { stdio: 'inherit', env: env }); process.exitCode = r.status || 0 }"
